read_file.description: Read a UTF-8 text file relative to the working directory.

write_file.description: Write UTF-8 text to a file relative to the working directory.

bash.description: Run a shell command in the working directory.

activate_skill.description: Load the full instructions for an allowed skill.

list_available_tools.description: List installed native and artifact tool names, descriptions, and session access without executing or granting access. Access states do not guarantee policy approval.

request_tool.description: Request a tool be added to this subagent for the current session.

reason.description: Why the task needs this tool.

tool_authoring.description: Create and activate a user-owned tool artifact that runs with an available command-line runtime.

files.description: Relative file paths mapped to text contents; may use any language supported by the selected runtime.

command.description: Command and arguments. Runs in the target project; use {artifact_dir} for bundled files and {workspace_dir} for the project. JSON arguments arrive on stdin. HARNESS_SKILL_DIRS contains allowed skill paths as JSON.
